# 1337Ops - Full Context & Knowledge Base

> Enterprise AI Automation, Cloud Architecture, and Security Solutions. Scale without increasing headcount.

## About 1337Ops
1337Ops is an elite technology consulting and engineering firm founded by Payton Forristal-Garcia, an industry veteran holding certifications including AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (SAA), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Certified Scrum Master (CSM), and Claude Certified Architect.

With 15+ years of enterprise experience across financial services, telecommunications, and SaaS (Prudential Financial, Freddie Mac, SWIFT, M&T Bank, SP Plus), 1337Ops bridges the gap between complex enterprise engineering and startup speed.

## Comprehensive Service Offerings

### 1. IT Consultation & Strategy
- Technology roadmap development and architecture reviews.
- Digital transformation, cloud migration strategy, and technical governance.
- Vendor evaluation, contract negotiation, and software selection.

### 2. AI Agents & Workflow Automation
- Custom AI agent development utilizing LangChain, LangGraph, and n8n.
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge bases and document processing pipelines.
- Intelligent automation to eliminate operational bottlenecks without increasing headcount.

### 3. Network Design, Implementation & Support
- LAN/WAN enterprise architecture, VLAN segmentation, and SD-WAN deployment.
- Wireless site surveys and high-density Wi-Fi 6/7 rollouts.
- 24/7 network monitoring, incident response, and proactive maintenance.

### 4. VoIP & Unified Communications
- Enterprise cloud PBX deployment (3CX, FreePBX, Microsoft Teams).
- SIP trunking, carrier management, and global number porting.
- Advanced IVR, auto-attendants, call queuing, and secure recording.

### 5. Website Design, Implementation & Support
- Modern, performant, and fully accessible web applications and landing pages.
- Headless CMS integration, e-commerce, and high-conversion UI/UX design.
- Core Web Vitals optimization and ongoing maintenance SLAs.

### 6. CyberSecurity Engagements (CEH Certified)
- Red Team: Adversary simulation, penetration testing, and web app vulnerability assessment.
- Blue Team: SOC optimization, SIEM/EDR engineering, and threat hunting.
- Purple Team: Collaborative exercises combining attack simulation and detection engineering.

### 7. Starlink Setup & Configuration
- Site survey, obstruction analysis, and professional mounting (roof, pole, ground).
- Enterprise router, mesh Wi-Fi, and multi-WAN failover/load balancing configuration.
- Business static IP routing, secure VPN integration, and remote site monitoring.

### 8. Agile Project Management
- Scrum and Kanban delivery for complex infrastructure and software initiatives.
- Risk management (RAID logs), sprint planning, and resource capacity modeling.
- Executive stakeholder reporting and program management governance.

### 9. Graphic Design & Brand Identity
- Logo design, wordmarks, and comprehensive brand guideline systems.
- Marketing collateral, pitch decks, signage, and trade show assets.
- Digital design systems, UI component libraries, and motion graphics.
